title: Pure R.B.
summary: Pure R.B. Machine combo and link-climbing deck, centered on monsters with equal ATK and DEF that self-summon and trigger bonus effects when linked to R.B. Link Monsters. The archetype relies on R.B. Stage Landing and R.B. Funk Dock to establish board presence, climbing into R.B. VALCan Booster, R.B. The Brute Blues, and R.B. Shepherd's Crook to loop destructions and set counter traps.

summary.title: Starters & Setup
points: R.B. Stage Landing: Premier one-card starter that Special Summons any R.B. monster directly from the Deck or Extra Deck.
R.B. Funk Dock: Field Spell searching any R.B. card on activation and floating into an R.B. monster from the Deck whenever an R.B. destroys itself.
R.B. Ga10 Cutter & R.B. Ga10 Driller: Free self-summoning extenders that provide Spell/Trap negation and quick monster destruction when linked to an R.B. Link Monster.
R.B. VALCan Rocket: Self-summoning extender that destroys up to two cards on the field and burns the opponent when linked.

summary.title: Opening Play
steps: Activate R.B. Stage Landing to Special Summon R.B. Lambda Blade from your Deck.
R.B. Lambda Blade triggers on summon to send an R.B. card (such as R.B. Last Stand) to the GY.
Special Summon R.B. Ga10 Driller or R.B. Ga10 Cutter from your hand using their innate summon conditions.
Link Summon R.B. VALCan Booster using Lambda Blade and Ga10 Driller.
R.B. VALCan Booster searches R.B. Funk Dock and Special Summons an R.B. monster from your hand or GY to its linked zone.
Activate R.B. Funk Dock to search R.B. Shepherd's Crook or an extender, then link into Link-3 R.B. Shepherd's Crook.
Shepherd's Crook Sets R.B. Next Phase or R.B. Last Stand directly from the Deck to establish disruption for the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: R.B. Shepherd's Crook: Link-3 boss setting archetype Traps directly from the Deck and reviving R.B. monsters on the opponent's turn.
R.B. The Brute Blues: Link-3 anchor searching R.B. cards and gaining destruction immunity while pointing to an R.B. monster.
Helping Robo for Underwater Combat: Generic Machine Link-2 destroying monsters, reviving R.B. monsters, and searching an equal-ATK/DEF monster when banished.
Clockwork Knight: Machine Link-2 searching Machine support and altering monster Types.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: R.B. Funk Dock: Continuous search and floating engine replenishing monsters upon self-destruction.
R.B. Next Phase: Counter Trap destroying an R.B. monster you control to negate an opposing monster effect and float with Funk Dock.
R.B. Last Stand: Summons an R.B. from Deck, Extra Deck, or GY, and banishes from GY to negate targeting effects.
R.B. Operation Test: Recycles high-level R.B. monsters from the GY for LP recovery and a fresh summon.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Machina, Clockwork, and Sky Striker hybrid engines are left out in favor of a pure R.B. Machine focus maximizing equal-ATK/DEF synergies.
